name: node-api
title: Node.js + TypeScript API
conventions: One folder per feature under src/features. Each feature exports a register function that src/routes/index.ts calls.
Tests for a feature live under tests/features/<feature> and use app.inject, not a running server.
Import local files with the .ts extension. Use only erasable TypeScript: no enums, namespaces, or parameter properties.
Tests open the database with openDatabase(":memory:").
